feature: COUNT aggregation with implicit GROUP BY over a one-hop pattern

scenarios.name: count of pg_node neighbors per hub
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/aggregation (COUNT grouped per hub key)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h:gryphon_playground__pg_hub)-[:PG_LINKS__gryphon_playground]->(n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) RETURN h.entity_id AS hub_id, COUNT(n) AS neighbor_count

scenarios.name: COUNT over a relationship omits zero-degree nodes
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS__gryphon_playground]->(n) RETURN h.entity_id AS source_id, COUNT(n) AS out_degree

scenarios.name: one AND constrains two different bound nodes — source and target each filtered before the COUNT
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match-where (a single AND constraining two distinct bound variables, each against a literal — distinct from a cross-variable comparison a.x = b.x, which v0 does not support)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h:gryphon_playground__pg_hub)-[:PG_LINKS__gryphon_playground]->(n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE h.data.severity_score = 0 AND n.data.severity_score > 15 RETURN h.entity_id AS hub_id, COUNT(n) AS high_neighbors
